children: Zipline is discussing a new funding round of about $1 billion that could value the drone delivery company at approximately $20 billion, Bloomberg News reported Wednesday, citing people familiar with the matter.
The potential valuation would be almost three times the California-based startup’s previous level, reflecting growing investor interest in autonomous delivery and logistics technology.

The talks remain at an early stage and the size and terms of the financing could still change, according to people familiar with the discussions who requested anonymity because the plans haven’t been announced.

For investors, the proposed valuation may provide a useful benchmark for publicly traded companies involved in drones, autonomous logistics and last-mile delivery. It also suggests private-market investors remain willing to commit substantial capital to technology businesses with potentially large commercial applications.

title: Zipline is said to seek $1B funding round at $20B valuation
